Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Exact actor: the unnamed monk. An unnamed monk asks Chushi Fanqi how ruler and minister accord.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 曰 marks the unnamed monk’s question; Chushi Fanqi answers 俱.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (蔗菴範禪師語錄). Exact actor: Zhe'an Fan. Zhe'an says the jeweled hall dances with jade light as ruler and minister accord.

Occurrences.Kwic: 正恁麼時，君臣道合、父子一如即不問，作麼生是轉身一句？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (入就瑞白禪師語錄). Exact actor: Ruibai Mingxue. Ruibai sets aside ruler-and-minister accord and father-and-son unity before asking for a turning phrase.
Source text (雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄). Exact actor: Langting Jingting. Langting says ruler and minister accord in one virtue and one mind.

Occurrences.Kwic: 君臣道合，海晏河清，猶是法身邊事。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)). Exact actor: Langya Huijue. Langya says ruler and minister accord and the seas are calm, yet this remains an affair beside the dharma body.
Source text (明覺聰禪師語錄). Exact actor: the unnamed monk. An unnamed monk asks Mingjue Cong about ruler-and-minister accord.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 僧問 introduces both headword-bearing parallel lines and the later question; Mingjue Cong answers only after 師云.

Senses.Explanation: Ruler and minister accord names a relation in which differentiated positions function together. Langting Jingting glosses it with “one virtue, one mind,” and Zhe’an Fan places it beside concord among brothers. Chushi Fanqi answers the direct question with “together.” Ruibai Mingxue sets the accord aside to demand a turning phrase, while Langya Huijue says that even an ordered realm with calm seas remains beside the dharma body. The records use political coordination as a relational model and then publicly test whether it exhausts the matter.
